title: Unity CLI Error Code
description: Structured error object used in the response envelope. Every failure includes stable retry and recovery fields; blocker observations use a sanitized public DTO.

code.description: Machine-readable error code from the taxonomy. Examples: E_UNITY_BUSY, E_EXECUTION_TIMEOUT, BRIDGE_CONNECTION_FAILED.

details.description: Additional structured business context. Transport endpoints, listener identity and native window handles are never public.

nextActions.description: Suggested recovery actions the caller (Agent or user) can take.

retryAfterMs.description: When the error is transient (e.g. E_UNITY_BUSY), suggested minimum retry delay in milliseconds. 0 = no specific recommendation.

transient.description: True if the error is transient (compiling, domain reload, import) and the same request may succeed after retry.
